head: working-tree
subject: Single-authority xdstp resource names
change: Added xds.resource_name parsing for old-style and xdstp:// names and runtime.Options.authority. The controller validates listener, route, cluster, EDS assignment and SDS secret names against the configured authority and expected short resource type. Old-style names remain valid; xdstp names without a configured authority or with a mismatched authority/type are rejected before subscription or publication.

tests.unit: src/grpc/xds/resource_name.zig covers old-style/xdstp parsing and authority/type matching. src/grpc/xds/runtime/authority_tests.zig covers matching xdstp listener/cluster/EDS names end to end, xdstp listener validation, and rejection of mismatched authority and type.

focused_gate.command: zig build test-lib -Dtest-filter='xDS runtime' -Dtest-filter='gRPC CDS' -Dtest-filter='gRPC LDS' -Dtest-filter='LRS' -Dtest-filter='SDS' -Dtest-filter='xdstp' --summary all

notes: Only one authority is served per controller. Multi-authority routing to separate ADS streams, percent-decoded authority canonicalization and authority-specific bootstrap selection remain open.
